description: Existing kitchen, 13 Nov 2026: the long wall with every wall cabinet open, counter and range below

extractions.what: Long-wall wall cabinets, left to right: water bottles, tumblers, a grater, a bin of chargers and cables, a round white tub; sunscreen, vitamins and medicine boxes; about ten liquor bottles, two of wine, bar books, napkins; 12 dinner plates, salad plates, pasta bowls, cereal bowls, serving bowls, a terracotta bowl; a large Tetley box, four squeeze bottles, a dark bottle, oven mitts, salt; over the hood a stack of foil pans, a spray bottle, a white jug, an aerosol can, thermoses. On the counter: toaster oven, compost bin beside the range, three cast-iron pans, a sheet pan, knife strip, utensil crock, microwave
